basic_details.offering_entity: University of Padua (Università degli Studi di Padova, Italy)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Padua (Padova, Italy - founded in 1222)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Exclusively open to English-taught Bachelor's and Master's degree programs across all university schools (Information Engineering, Physics, Industrial Engineering, Economics, Medicine & Health, Psychology, Agricultural Sciences).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~53 highly competitive merit scholarships awarded annually across all university departments
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition without national quotas (typically 2 to 6 Pakistani awardees annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Full normative duration of the course: 3 years for Bachelor's, 2 years for Master's

nationality_requirements: Non-Italian citizenship and prior educational qualifications obtained outside of Italy
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: High school diploma (12 years of education) for Bachelor's applicants; accredited undergraduate degree (16 years of education) for Master's applicants.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Award is granted to the highest-scoring admitted candidates in each English-taught degree program; admitted scholars typically hold a CGPA above 3.60 / 4.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Adequate academic background in mathematics and target discipline corresponding to program requirements.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year student graduating before the autumn enrollment deadline.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not required; purely academic and merit-driven.

english_proficiency.notes: English B2 certificate required; Medium of Instruction certificate accepted by many degree programs if undergraduate education was conducted entirely in English.

eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Must not hold another Italian national or regional scholarship.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver for each year of study (standard regional tax of ~€190–200/year applies).

admission_application_fee.details: Padua application fee (€30 per degree program) paid by applicant on Apply.unipd.it.

accommodation.details: Paid by student out of gross annual scholarship; ESU Padova student housing options available (~€250–380/mo).

monthly_stipend.details: €8,000 gross per academic year (disbursed in 2 installments of €4,000 per year upon reaching academic credit milestones). Net amount approximately €666/month.

visa_fee.details: Italian National Visa Type D fee (€116) borne by applicant; pre-enrollment via Universitaly.it.

health_insurance.details: Italian National Health Service (SSN) voluntary registration (~€150/yr for students) paid by student.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized meals at ESU Padova student canteens (~€3.50 to €5.50 per full meal).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Library and academic digital repositories freely accessible.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Access to Erasmus+ study and traineeship mobility grants across Europe during degree.

travel_transit_allowance.details: None; initial funds must be brought by student.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution: University of Padua (Università degli Studi di Padova).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: #236 QS World University Rankings 2025; Top 10 in Italy; #1 in Italy for research quality.
available_majors: Computer Engineering & Cybersecurity, Control Systems Engineering, Data Science, Astrophysics & Cosmology, Physics of Data, Environmental Engineering, Biotechnologies for Food Science, Sustainable Agriculture, Medicine & Surgery (6-Year), Psychological Science
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 24 months for Master's; 36 months for Bachelor's
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's degree or high school diploma with strong academic record in mathematics and chosen discipline.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Data Science, Control Systems, and Medicine are among the most competitive courses.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Apply during Application Call 1 (November - February) rather than Call 2, as the vast majority of Excellence Scholarships are allocated in Call 1.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: University of Padua International Admissions Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on Apply.unipd.it, choose up to 3 English-taught degree programs, and submit supporting academic files.
step_by_step_workflow: 3. Upload academic transcripts, degree certificates, CV, and motivation letter.
4. Pay the €30 application fee per program.
5. Complete application before early February deadline.
6. Academic committee ranks applicants; top candidates awarded Excellence Scholarship.
8. Complete Universitaly.it pre-enrollment and apply for Italian Type D visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated automatic consideration through Apply.unipd.it admission portal.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded directly by applicant or requested via referee email link.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Detailed motivation letter explaining academic interest, background preparation, and future professional goals in Padua.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online interview conducted by select departments (e.g. Data Science, Medicine, Control Systems) via Zoom.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: None for most Master's programs; IMAT required for 6-year Medicine & Surgery; TOLC test required for select Bachelor's.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: €30 non-refundable application fee per degree program.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Declaration of Value (DOV) from Embassy of Italy in Islamabad or CIMEA Statement of Comparability & Verification.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: All documents must be in English or officially translated into Italian.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned copy of international passport data page
Complete transcripts and degrees with grading scales
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC Pakistan and MOFA

required_documents_checklist.specification: Europass or academic CV detailing projects and skills
IELTS Academic (6.5+), TOEFL iBT (80+), or Medium of Instruction certificate

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Non-EU international applicants must apply during Call 1 to be considered for the Excellence Scholarship.

selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Academic Degree Programme Committees of respective University of Padua faculties.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Academic ranking of all admitted students in each eligible degree course -> Top student in each degree nominated for the Padua Excellence Award.

competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: 53 Excellence Scholarships across all university faculties
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Top-of-class graduates with exceptional GPA, strong mathematical training, and relevant project portfolios.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani universities in engineering, physics, and computing.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: India, Turkey, Iran, China, Russia, Brazil, Lebanon, Pakistan.

fake_websites_and_scams: Commercial sites claiming to secure Padua scholarships: unipd-admissions.com, italy-student-visas.org.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Official application fee is strictly €30 per course paid solely via Apply.unipd.it. Do not pay agents.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: University of Padua does not work with agencies that charge money to promise scholarships.
itemized_hidden_out_of_pocket_costs: CIMEA Statement of Comparability / DOV legalization (~PKR 45,000 to 75,000)
Italian student visa application fee and VFS charges (~PKR 40,000)
debunked_myths_and_misconceptions: MYTH: You need to apply separately for the scholarship. (Truth: You are automatically evaluated when applying to the degree program).
MYTH: If you miss this award, you have no funding. (Truth: Admitted students can apply for regional need-based DSU scholarships which provide free accommodation and meals).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Agents claim all admitted students get €8,000; in reality, only 53 students across the entire university receive the International Excellence Award.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must acquire at least 20 ECTS by February of Year 1 and 40 ECTS by August of Year 1 to receive second installment and Year 2 renewal.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Regular participation in lectures and laboratory sessions.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Achievement of required ECTS credits by official session deadlines.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Legally allowed to work up to 20 hours per week (1,040 hours per year) in Italy under a student residence permit.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; graduates can register for a 1-year Permesso di Soggiorno per Ricerca Lavoro (job search permit).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: If academic credit thresholds are not met, the second installment of the scholarship is cancelled and tuition fee waiver revoked.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing degree program results in immediate loss of the scholarship.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Strictly non-extendable beyond the normative 2 years (Master's) or 3 years (Bachelor's).
